participants.name: Personal Customer
participants.description: The individual applying for the residential mortgage. The primary actor throughout the journey. May be acting alone or as one of two applicants in a joint mortgage application.

phase_interactions.description: Submits property details (address, purchase price, property type), deposit amount, income details, and selects a mortgage product. Reviews the indicative affordability pre-check result.
phase_interactions.notification_sent: Affordability pre-check result displayed in-app/portal. No credit check performed.

phase_interactions.description: Provides full income and employment details. Consents to soft credit check. Receives DIP document (European Standardised Information Sheet, ESIS) if approved. DIP is used to demonstrate borrowing capacity to estate agents and vendors.
phase_interactions.notification_sent: DIP approval email and downloadable DIP certificate. Or: DIP declined notification with reason summary.

phase_interactions.description: Submits full formal application: personal details, property details, financial position. Uploads income documents (payslips, P60, self-assessment returns) and bank statements. Consents to hard credit check.
phase_interactions.notification_sent: Application received confirmation with reference number and expected decision timeline.

phase_interactions.description: Pays valuation fee. Receives notification when valuation is instructed and when the valuation report has been received. In the event of a down-valuation, receives notification with options.
phase_interactions.notification_sent: Valuation instructed confirmation. Valuation report received notification. Down-valuation notification (if applicable) with options.

phase_interactions.description: May be contacted by underwriter for additional information or clarification. Receives underwriting decision notification.
phase_interactions.notification_sent: Underwriting decision email: approve (proceed to offer), refer (conditions and information required), or decline (FOS signpost included per Consumer Duty).

phase_interactions.description: Receives formal Mortgage Offer document. Has 7-day reflection period. Reviews offer with solicitor/conveyancer. Formally accepts the offer via online portal or in branch.
channel: post (binding offer must be provided in durable medium)
phase_interactions.notification_sent: Mortgage offer email with attached offer document. Reminder notification after 5 days if not yet accepted. Acceptance confirmation on acceptance.

phase_interactions.description: Notified when mortgage funds are released via CHAPS on completion day. Receives MortgageAccount welcome pack with account details, mortgage schedule, first payment date, and direct debit confirmation.
phase_interactions.notification_sent: Funds released confirmation. Mortgage account welcome pack (email and post). Direct debit confirmation.

participants.name: Mortgage Underwriter
participants.description: The bank's mortgage underwriter responsible for reviewing the full application pack and making the credit decision. Works within defined credit policy parameters. Escalates complex cases to PER-051 (Credit Analyst).

phase_interactions.description: Reviews the complete application pack: credit report, affordability assessment, income verification, valuation report, and AML check results. Makes final underwriting decision: approve, refer, or decline. Documents decision rationale in the underwriting system. Issues conditions for referred applications.
Reviews and approves mortgage offer document before it is issued to the customer. Ensures offer terms reflect the underwriting decision and any conditions are accurately reflected.

participants.name: Credit Analyst
participants.description: Senior credit analyst engaged for complex cases referred by the mortgage underwriter. Handles applications with unusual income structures (self-employed, contractor, multiple income sources), high LTV, or borderline affordability.

phase_interactions.description: Engaged by PER-055 for complex applications. Reviews structural income analysis, assesses non-standard employment scenarios, and provides a credit analysis report to support the underwriting decision. Makes recommendation to PER-055 or has direct decision authority above a defined loan threshold.

participants.name: Surveyor
participants.description: RICS-qualified external surveyor or AVM (Automated Valuation Model) provider appointed by the bank to value the subject property. Produces the valuation report that gates underwriting. Not an agent of the bank for legal purposes.

phase_interactions.description: Receives valuation instruction from SVC-002. Conducts property inspection (for drive-by or full structural valuations) or runs AVM model (desktop). Produces RICS Red Book compliant valuation report specifying the market value. Returns report to SVC-002.

participants.name: Solicitor / Conveyancer
participants.description: The customer's solicitor or licensed conveyancer who manages the legal aspects of the property purchase. Receives the mortgage offer, conducts searches, handles exchange of contracts, and requests funds on completion day.

phase_interactions.description: Receives a copy of the mortgage offer document from the bank (standard MCOB requirement). Reviews offer terms, identifies and clarifies any conditions, advises the customer on the offer.

Confirms completion date to the bank. Submits requisition for funds on completion day. Receives CHAPS funds from the bank. Transfers funds to vendor's solicitor. Registers legal charge at Land Registry. Reports completion to the bank.

interaction_matrix.description: Summary of which participants are active in each phase
